title: Sensor capability information (v1.1)
description: What the device actually has, as verified by real API checks (Stage 2). v1.1 adds the per-hardware capability-state fields; the v1 boolean fields remain for compatibility. capability_state is one of: AVAILABLE, UNAVAILABLE, PERMISSION_DENIED, UNKNOWN, NOT_IMPLEMENTED. null means 'unknown — not probed yet'. Never assume LiDAR or depth hardware exists.

camera_available.description: v1 field, kept for compatibility. v1.1 prefers camera.capability_state.

depth_sensor_available.description: True only after a verified depth/LiDAR probe; null until then.

camera_permission.description: PERMISSION_DENIED covers both askable and permanently-denied; see camera_permission_permanent when present.

camera_permission_permanent.description: True when the OS reports the permission can never be asked again (must be granted in Settings).
